fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on Miami bankers and credit conditions, municipal bond debt, and calls for investigation of bank practices; reports on industrial delays affecting Miami River boatbuilding; discussion of a new "Greater Miami Harbor Plan" including causeways and an airport; notes on slot machine destruction by police and prohibition enforcement; civic items on hurricane warning visibility, post office site selection, traffic hazards, courthouse facilities, and ordinances affecting sugar storage and shipping; business commentary on dairy consolidation and milk distribution costs; plus society column and realty-related anecdotes.
